transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess I’m here because I’m just… tired all the time. Even if I sleep through the night, I still feel worn down, and after work and dealing with things around the house, I don’t have much left.
Do you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep during the night?
I don’t know… not really, I guess. I haven’t paid much attention to whether I’m waking up a lot.
Do you find yourself feeling unusually sleepy during the day, even after a full night's sleep?
Yeah… I guess so. Even when I sleep a full night, I still feel worn down most of the day. By the time I get through work and stuff at home, there’s not much left.
Even when you sleep a full night, do you still feel like you could fall asleep easily during the day, like in quiet situations or after sitting for a few minutes?
I’m not really sure. I feel drained, but I don’t know that I’d say I’m actually about to fall asleep just from sitting quietly.
Have you noticed that your tiredness is accompanied by feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. Most days it’s like there’s this kind of low mood in the background. I can still go to the lab and talk to people, but things don’t feel… light, I guess. Even stuff I used to enjoy, like baking or checking the telescope, doesn’t really feel the same.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, or found it hard to concentrate on tasks? Also, do you ever feel excessively guilty or like you’re not worth much?

Concentration, yeah… that’s been harder. Things that used to be pretty straightforward, like revising a grant paragraph or deciding what materials I need for a repair at home, take longer now. My mind just feels slower, and I keep second-guessing small choices.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities you once looked forward to, like baking or using the telescope?

Yeah… I guess I don’t. I still do those things sometimes, but it’s more like I’m going through the motions. Most days there’s just this low, gray feeling in the background, and I don’t really get excited about baking or checking the telescope like I used to.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy levels or an increase in fatigue, even after resting or sleeping?
Yeah… I’m tired most of the time. Even if I sleep through the night, I still feel kind of worn down. After work and dealing with stuff around the house, I don’t have much left.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed most of the day, even when nothing particularly bad is happening?

Yeah… most days, I’d say so. It’s not always dramatic or anything. It’s just this low, gray feeling in the background. I can still go to the lab and talk to people, but I don’t feel light or excited about things much.
Have you found yourself feeling like you’re not worth much, or do you often feel guilty about things, even when you know you’re not really at fault?
I don’t know… not in a big way, I guess. I can get hard on myself sometimes, but I’m not sure I’d say I feel worthless or guilty all the time.
Do you find that you don’t take pleasure in most things you do these days, even things that used to make you feel good?
I’m not sure I’d say most things. Some things still feel okay, I guess. Maybe not as much as they used to, but… I wouldn’t say I get no pleasure from them.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have others mentioned that you seem slowed down? Or on the other hand, have you felt restless or fidgety, like you can't sit still?
Not really, no. I don’t think anyone’s said I seem slowed down, and I don’t feel especially restless either.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or wished you were dead, even if you didn’t have a specific plan for harming yourself?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I get worn down sometimes, but I haven’t been wishing I was dead or anything like that.
How long have you been feeling this way — this low mood and loss of enjoyment in things?
I guess… a little over two years. It kind of started after we moved into the older house, and it’s just been my baseline since then.
Have you had periods of feeling down or losing interest in things more than once in the past two years, or has this been a continuous low mood since it started?
It’s been more continuous, I think. Like… not separate episodes exactly. Just kind of a low baseline since not long after we moved into that older house, a little over two years ago.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like baking or using the telescope, or do you still have some interest, even if it’s not as strong as it used to be?

I wouldn’t say completely lost. I still… I can do those things sometimes. It’s more like most days there’s this gray feeling in the background, and I don’t get that lightness or excitement from baking or looking through the telescope like I used to.
